title: Regression
description: Draw the straight line that misses a cloud of points by the least. Turn an enzyme's curve upside down and it becomes one (Lineweaver and Burk).

puzzle.goal: Turn an enzyme's speed upside down: write 1/v, R, as a straight line in 1/S, from its top speed V and constant K.
puzzle.name: Lineweaver-Burk
puzzle.ask: Find R for K = @{K}, V = @{V} and S = @{S}.
puzzle.method: v = VS/(K + S), so 1/v = (K + S)/(VS) = (K/V)(1/S) + 1/V: slope K/V, intercept 1/V.
